data.name: Copy the current week's draft to the next week. If the next week already has shifts or modifications, confirmation is required before copying; saving is still required after copying. Vertical buttons on the sides can expand the 36 hours before and after the current week; gray areas are read-only. Charts and forms on this page only edit the current week; to adjust adjacent weeks, switch to the corresponding week. The next week's draft after copying is also previewed in read-only mode. Changes to the current week and copies are saved, undone, and restored uniformly; collapsing does not lose drafts.
data.value: Copy the current week's draft to the following week. If the following week already contains shifts or changes, you must confirm before copying. You must still save after copying. Use the vertical buttons at the sides to expand the view to include the 36 hours before and after the current week; grey areas are read-only. The charts and forms on this page only allow you to edit the current week. To adjust adjacent weeks, switch to the relevant week. The following week's draft is also shown as a read-only preview after copying. Changes to the current week and copies are saved, undone and restored together; collapsing the view does not discard drafts.
